s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent colicky abdominal pain with rectal bleeding and mucopurulent discharge
salient_findings: intermittent colicky pain in the left iliac fossa
blood-mixed stool
large amounts of mucopurulent discharge per rectum
exophytic mass at the descending–sigmoid junction
intussusception of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon
key_facts: no family history of gastrointestinal disease
unremarkable abdominal and digital rectal examinations
exophytic mass at the descending–sigmoid junction
surface exudates and erosions on the mass
well-defined hypodense lesion with fat density in the sigmoid-colon wall

shortlist.label: Colorectal adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: exophytic mass at the descending–sigmoid junction with surface exudates and erosions

shortlist.label: Intussusception of the colon
shortlist.why_kept: invagination of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon consistent with intussusception

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: well-defined hypodense lesion with fat density in the sigmoid-colon wall

shortlist.label: Colonic polyp
shortlist.why_kept: exophytic mass at the descending–sigmoid junction

shortlist.label: Diverticulitis
shortlist.why_kept: intermittent colicky abdominal pain with rectal bleeding and mucopurulent discharge

raw.rationale: The presence of an exophytic mass at the descending–sigmoid junction with surface exudates and erosions, along with invagination of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon consistent with intussusception on CT, supports this diagnosis. The normal carcinoembryonic antigen level also reduces the likelihood of colorectal adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Colorectal adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Normal carcinoembryonic antigen level and the specific imaging findings of intussusception

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: No specific evidence of a spindle cell tumor on imaging or histology

rejected.label: Colonic polyp
rejected.why: The size and appearance of the mass are not typical for a polyp

rejected.label: Diverticulitis
rejected.why: The presence of an exophytic mass and intussusception are not characteristic of diverticulitis
